C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252.Summary: Replace the hidden plan lifecycle dropdown with a persistent desktop `Текущие | Архив` segmented control.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252.Problem: The primary current/archive register mode is hidden among ordinary filters and requires an unnecessary menu interaction.

Goals.Goal: Show `Текущие | Архив` permanently in the desktop plans toolbar.
Reuse the existing server-side `status=active|archived` state and data loader.
Keep search and ordinary filters, while preventing stale plan detail after switching mode.
Provide visible focus, explicit selected semantics and a minimum 44 pixel target.

Constraints.Constraint: No API, SQLite schema, migration, lifecycle command, evidence, source-row or document-intake change.
No separate mobile mode, mobile navigation, bottom sheet, gesture or mobile-only transition is designed or implemented.
The existing narrow layout remains unchanged and is not a separate release surface for this change.
Lifecycle view is never-learn: statistics cannot choose, reorder or reposition the modes.
No CDN, Docker, cloud, Internet or LLM dependency is added.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Redesign remaining filters or the plan detail.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `Текущие | Архив` is permanently visible in the desktop toolbar and switches mode with one click, Enter, Space or horizontal arrow action.
The old lifecycle select is hidden from visual and accessibility navigation but remains an internal compatibility bridge to the existing controller.
The visible control uses tablist/tab semantics, correct aria-selected state, roving tabindex and at least a 44 pixel target.
Search and ordinary filter values survive switching; an absent selected plan never leaves stale detail visible.
Empty current and archive results use distinct text when no secondary condition explains the empty set.
No animation is required; `prefers-reduced-motion` produces the same immediate semantic result.
Focused desktop tests, full project CI and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves one-action desktop lifecycle navigation without a data-contract or mobile-mode change.
